entities.summary: Khaled Khoja is a Syrian-Turkish politician. He was the president of the National Coalition for Syrian Revolutionary and Opposition Forces from 2015 to 2016. He was born to a Turkish family, and can speak both Turkish and Arabic. He is a Turkish citizen since 1993.
